what: The benchmark's warm primary reachability walks took 15 s twice and 232 ms once despite all three finding 10,847 cached records and compiling none. The fast primary had already verified the final distributed tail in the same Maker; its start.txt counted 14,698 known-answer entry hits versus 3,926 and 3,986 in the other samples.
cost: Peer recipients repeated expensive verification preparation after waiting for the leader. The benchmark reported about 17 million allocations in each slow walk; the contribution of individual preparation kinds is not yet measured.
cause: Whole-entry read-answer reuse is process-local. Additionally, a partially known entry prepares every preparation row even when a prior successful entry already proved its exact question and answer.
whys: The distributed leader completes the transitive walk, then each exporter performs its own walk over the received records.
Only the leader's Maker retains the answers proved by that first walk.
The verifier's existing fast path tests whether the entire entry is known; a partial miss re-enters preparation for all preparation rows.
verify_today already reuses individual exact answers, but the earlier preparation loop did not consult that proof.
class: Preparation repeats work already covered by a narrower proof whenever a coarse proof misses.
prevention: Consult the same exact Answers proof before decoding and preparing non-coroutine rows. Preserve re-lay roots for temporary coroutine layouts and validate every read through verify_today. Causal tests compare a retained maker with a fresh one and reject changed known and unknown constant answers.
workaround: none; do not warm up the benchmark or trust peer arrival as verification
fix: Implemented exact partial-row proof reuse and cumulative maker preparation counters. Native f20_read_lists passed 10/10 and six selected d106 records/coroutine controls passed; the release CLI check passed. A matched benchmark of baseline and candidate source/binary identities remains pending, so no speedup is claimed.
state: open; native validation passed, matched benchmark pending
